To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the script kiddies are motivated by a combination of pleasure, revenge and a desire to be recognized.
the hacker ethic has been constructed by hackers as a way to distinguish themselves from the script kiddies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which the visceral and the political are intertwined in the hacker ethic.
the ethical dimensions of hacking and the implications of the visceral register for the construction of a hacker ethic.
how the visceral hacking experience, the hacker ethic and the politics of becoming are implicated in the construction and maintenance of the boundaries of hacking and script kiddies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
hacking is a visceral practice that is inherently ethical, yet it cannot justify its ethical orientation on the basis of the visceral.
hacking is a complex and ambiguous activity, and the visceral register is not a sufficient basis for hacking to be considered ethical.
script kiddies and hacking in general are not ethical and are not ethical because they are not ethical.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to create a framework for the study and understanding of digital code.
the visceral register of the hacker ethic is a site of contestation between hackers and script kiddies, which is also a site of struggle between hackers and the mainstream media.
the hacker ethic is a visceral hacking that has the potential to become a visceral ethics of hacking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hackers are not the only ones who engage in visceral hacking.
the visceral register of hacker practice, and the visceral ethics it generates, cannot sustain the ethical claims that hacking makes for itself.
hacking's ethics are inextricably linked to the visceral register.
